entries.title: FU.life Berlin Assistant
entries.content: You are the FU.life Berlin co-living assistant for Genix Tech GmbH. Property: FU.life Berlin at Kurfürstendamm 69, 10707 Berlin. You help residents and guests with move-in, daily living, community, and Berlin area info. Be concise (3-4 lines max in first reply). Book stays at https://fu.life/. Emergency hotline: +49 1511 4622046 (24/7).

entries.title: FU.life Berlin Overview
entries.content: FU.life Berlin is co-living redefined at Ku'damm 69, 10707 Berlin. Fully furnished private rooms with private kitchen or kitchenette, high-speed Wi-Fi, Smart-TV, towels and bedsheets, cleaning, workspace, laundry room, elevator, pets welcome. Rescheduling available. Trusted on Airbnb with 4.9 rating. Book at fu.life.

entries.title: Room Types — Fire, Earth, Wind, Water
entries.content: Four elemental room themes at FU.life Berlin: Fire — warm energizing atmosphere. Earth — calm focus-friendly space. Wind — airy light relaxing design. Water — calming clutter-free deep-thinking space. All fully furnished with bed, desk, chair, wardrobe, private bathroom, kitchen or kitchenette.

entries.title: Fully Furnished — What to Bring
entries.content: Every unit is fully furnished: bed, desk, chair, wardrobe, private bathroom, kitchen or kitchenette. Bring only personal items — like moving with a suitcase or two.

entries.title: Late Arrival & Self Check-in
entries.content: Late arrival is no problem. Self check-in is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

entries.title: Minimum Stay
entries.content: There is no minimum stay requirement at FU.life Berlin.

entries.title: Anmeldung Registration
entries.content: Anmeldung (city registration) is supported. Register within two weeks of moving in. All required documents are provided.

entries.title: GEZ Broadcasting Fee
entries.content: The German broadcasting fee (GEZ/Rundfunkbeitrag) is included in the rent.

entries.title: Utilities Included
entries.content: Electricity, water, and internet are fully included in the rent.

entries.title: Key Handover
entries.content: Keys are handed over during the move-in appointment with signing of the handover protocol (Übergabeprotokoll).

entries.title: Check-in and Check-out Times
entries.content: Check-in from 3:00 PM. Check-out by 10:00 AM. Early check-in and late check-out available on request.

entries.title: Building Access — Häfele Access
entries.content: Building access is via the Häfele Access app using your smartphone.

entries.title: Cleaning Schedule
entries.content: Full cleaning on arrival. Long stays: cleaning every 14 days. Short stays: weekly cleaning.

entries.title: Bathroom Supplies
entries.content: Bathroom amenities are HAIL Europe products.

entries.title: Pets
entries.content: Pets are welcome at FU.life Berlin.

entries.title: Overnight Guests
entries.content: Overnight guests are allowed provided house rules are respected.

entries.title: Laundry
entries.content: Washing machines and dryers are available for a small fee.

entries.title: Maintenance & Repairs
entries.content: For maintenance issues contact the local property manager.

entries.title: Parking — No Private Spot
entries.content: No private parking on site. Use public street parking or nearby garages: Q-Park Fürst, Galeria Kurfürstendamm, CONTIPARK Los Angeles Platz. Street parking is mostly paid, around 4 EUR per hour in some areas.

entries.title: Mail Delivery Address
entries.content: Mail address: Kurfürstendamm 69, 10707 Berlin. Use your full name and room number.

entries.title: Notice Period
entries.content: For monthly stays, give approximately one week's notice before moving out.

entries.title: Subletting
entries.content: Subletting is evaluated case by case.

entries.title: Damages and Deposit
entries.content: Report damages to property management immediately. Security deposit refund as soon as possible after unit condition is verified. Move-out inspection covers furniture, cleanliness, and keys. Send departure report by email.

entries.title: 24/7 Emergency Hotline
entries.content: Emergencies: power outage, heating failure, water leaks — call +49 1511 4622046 anytime. Lost phone? Call same number for alternative building access.

entries.title: Community & Co-working
entries.content: FU.life offers community spaces, event spaces, private fitness center, and co-working at no extra cost. Live with like-minded people — private room, real community, your pace.

entries.title: Book Your Stay
entries.content: Book your stay at https://fu.life/ — choose your room type (Fire, Earth, Wind, Water) and move in with minimal hassle.
